name: Variety Show
description: Come show us what you've got! Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling. Audition Videos due by 3/1, Dress Rehearsal on 3/19, Show on 3/20.

name: Uniform Closet Organization
description: The front office is in need of two volunteers to help organize the uniform closet during the minimum days we have in March (12th and 13th) after school.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday).
